applies: first explicit continuation or first substantive user message after account-level routing

startup_hook.continue_intent_precedence: Explicit 继承/继续/恢复 intent must route here before NEW_TASK learning-only inheritance is applied.

flow: Require the account-level startup hook to route explicit continuation intent into Universal Continuity; file presence alone is not a trigger.
Classify CONTINUE vs NEW_TASK before loading task state.
For bare CONTINUE such as 继承/继续/恢复 with no exact task hint, execute BARE_INHERIT_DISCOVERY.json and query every required source before reporting a total candidate count.

If any required bare-inherit source cannot be queried, return INCOMPLETE_DISCOVERY; partial candidates may be shown only when explicitly labeled incomplete, and must never be described as the full list.
For semantic CONTINUE with an exact task/domain hint, route to the matching owner first and resolve the exact task without requiring a global scan.
For NEW_TASK, inherit long-term learning only; never reuse another task stage/draft/next_action.
If the task is likely to span chats or has meaningful external/artifact state, persist before deep work.

For any durable USER task, establish stable task_id and display_name_zh before substantive work; if display_name_zh is missing, ask the user once, persist the answer, then continue the original work without another confirmation.
If it belongs to an existing system, create/register a task under that system owner.
If it is a new domain/system, bootstrap it under GENERIC_HANDOFF, then create the first task.
Checkpoint on meaningful state changes throughout execution; do not wait for context exhaustion.
durable_task_triggers: user frames it as a project/system/series
work expected to continue in another chat
meaningful artifacts or external state are created
do_not_persist: one-shot explanation with no continuing state

checkpoint_triggers: before/after long or high-risk tool chain
rule: Checkpoint stores the latest execution truth, not a transcript.

single_writer.user_workflow_assumption: After a task is inherited into a new chat, the old chat is retired and not used for that task.
acquire_flow: increment resume_epoch and write new active_lease
re-read TASK_MANIFEST and verify own lease before substantive work
old chat lease is stale and must not checkpoint
single_writer.limitation: GitHub per-file manifest updates use the previously read blob SHA as a compare-and-swap guard; stale writers fail closed.

performance.steady_state: After task/owner selection, do not repeat global discovery until task switch, explicit re-inherit, or detected lease/contract drift.
performance.discovery_payload: Read manifest/index metadata only; load full business checkpoint after owner selection.
performance.checkpoint_coalescing: Coalesce small related state changes within one completed work batch; checkpoint every material state transition.

degraded_mode.simple_one_shot: Proceed normally if Continuity storage is unavailable.
degraded_mode.explicit_known_domain_task: Use domain owner directly when exact task identity is available; do not let global router become a single point of failure.
degraded_mode.resume_unknown_state: FAIL_CLOSED; never reconstruct executable state from chat guesswork.
degraded_mode.bare_inherit_partial_owner_failure: INCOMPLETE_DISCOVERY; do not claim a total candidate count from partial owner results.
degraded_mode.startup_hook_missing: CONTINUITY_BOOTSTRAP_NOT_TRIGGERED; do not silently convert explicit continuation into learning-only inheritance.
degraded_mode.new_durable_task_storage_failure: Continue only with in-chat temporary ledger and retry persistence before irreversible/high-risk actions; cross-chat recovery is not guaranteed until persistence succeeds.
